source: IBO 2018 理论考试 2（Theoretical Exam 2）第 15 题

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: At saturating levels of substrate, the rate of an enzyme catalysed reaction is proportional to the enzyme concentration

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: If enough substrate is added, the Vinax of an enzyme catalysed reaction in the presence of a non-competitive inhibitor can be the same as Vmax of the reaction in absence of the inhibitor

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The rate of an enzyme catalysed reaction in the presence of a rate-limiting concentration of substrate decreases with time

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The sigmoidal shape of the V versus S curve obtained with allosteric enzymes indicates that the affinity of the enzyme for substrate decreases as the substrate concentration is increased

subQuestions.label: E
subQuestions.text: The affinity of an allosteric enzyme for substrate varies with enzyme concentration
